overview: A pedestrian-focused residential and retail district in Muwaileh. Alef’s master-community page lists 3,660+ apartments across 56 buildings on a three-million-square-foot site. Its master-page three-zone summary names Souks, Seerah and Raseel; the current property directory also lists Hamsa and Palace Residences. These are different published scopes, not a fresh combined inventory count.
Alef’s 4 May 2026 update reports residential handovers progressing. A March 2025 release concerned completion of Seerah phase-one structural work, not finished apartments across the whole community.
research.locationNote: Muwaileh, Sharjah, near Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road; the community address uses Khalid Bin Sultan Al Qasimi Boulevard.
research.priceNote: No single current developer starting price was verified for this master community. Property Finder’s AED 629,000 launch reference concerns Souq Al Mamsha specifically; it is not a current quotation for every building.
research.paymentNote: The portal reference below is for Souq Al Mamsha only. Completed homes, Seerah, Raseel and Hamsa require their own unit-specific terms; no universal community payment plan was verified.
research.handoverNote: Alef’s current directory labels Souks ready to move, Seerah Q4 2026, Raseel Q4 2028 and Hamsa Q1 2029. Separately, the construction dashboard shows June 2030 for the overall Al Mamsha programme, at 73% overall progress; its relative update label does not provide a precise measurement date. These references do not certify every building’s completion.
